title: Bootstrap repo and CI
description: Initialize monorepo layout, add lint/test workflows, and enforce formatting.
prompt: Create GitHub Actions for lint, unit tests, and typecheck; fail fast on PRs.

title: Project deploy endpoint
description: Implement start/deploy API route and wire to job runner with idempotency key.
prompt: Expose POST /deploy with idempotency; return deployment_id and status URL.

title: Task numbering + ULID storage
description: Persist tasks with per-project sequence; enforce uniqueness and regex on number.
prompt: Backfill sequence for existing tasks; ensure number = {SLUG}-{sequence_no}.

title: Mermaid diagram update hook
description: Update project Mermaid diagram on task changes; store last rendered source.
prompt: When update_task runs, regenerate Mermaid from graph + task states.

title: Audit log for task updates
description: Record who changed status/description, store diff summary for support.

title: Container build cache tuning
description: Speed up image builds using BuildKit cache mounts and pinned base layers.
prompt: Apply docker buildx caching; avoid invalidating cache on dependency installs.

title: Rate limit deploy requests
description: Add per-IP and per-project rate limiting to deploy endpoint; return 429.
prompt: Implement token bucket; include Retry-After header and request_id in body.

title: Retry stuck deploy jobs
description: Detect jobs stuck in running > 30m; retry with backoff and cap attempts.
prompt: Add job heartbeat; mark attempt count; surface retry_reason in status output.

title: Get project details endpoint
description: Implement GET /projects/{id} returning slug, status, default prompt metadata.
prompt: Return minimal JSON with timestamps; include deployed_version if present.

title: Get task prompt resolution
description: Implement get_prompt: task.prompt overrides project.default_prompt when set.
prompt: If task.prompt null, return project.default_prompt; include effective_prompt field.

title: Task list pagination
description: Add cursor pagination for GET /projects/{id}/tasks; support status filter.
prompt: Use created_at+id cursor; default page size 50; allow ?status=done.

title: Knowledge graph schema
description: Define nodes/edges for projects, tasks, files, endpoints; version the schema.
prompt: Produce a compact JSON schema for graph entities and relations used by updates.

title: Graph update on deploy
description: On successful deploy, attach artifact nodes (image tag, commit sha) to project.
prompt: Write update rules: Project -> Deployment -> Artifact; include timestamps.

title: Mermaid edge labels
description: Include edge labels for owns/depends_on/deploys; keep diagram under 200 nodes.
prompt: Generate Mermaid with subgraphs per domain; collapse files into package nodes.

title: API key expiry enforcement
description: Reject expired keys at auth middleware; include error_code KEY_EXPIRED.
prompt: Add exp check; log key_id, project_id; return 401 with stable JSON shape.

title: Signed webhook payloads
description: Sign outgoing deploy webhooks with HMAC and include timestamp header.
prompt: Use header X-CodeRide-Signature v1; include UNIX ts; reject replays > 5m.

title: Task detail page
description: Render task title, status, prompt, and last updated; allow inline edit.
prompt: Design for keyboard-first editing; show status transitions as buttons.

title: Status change confirmation
description: Confirm cancel transitions and show reason field; avoid accidental cancels.
prompt: Only require confirm for cancelled; store reason in description suffix.

title: Prompt templates library
description: Create reusable prompt snippets (tone, constraints, JSON-only) and compose per task.
prompt: Implement template registry; allow variables: {slug},{task_number},{goal}.

title: Auto-summarize task descriptions
description: Generate short description summary when user pastes long text; cap at 180 chars.
prompt: Use extractive summary; do not rewrite code blocks; store in description.

title: Deploy status polling
description: Expose GET /deployments/{id} with live status and last log line pointer.
prompt: Return statuses: queued/running/succeeded/failed; include started_at, finished_at.

title: Request correlation IDs
description: Generate request_id per API call; propagate to logs and responses.
prompt: Accept X-Request-Id if valid ULID; otherwise generate; echo in response header.

title: GitHub App installation flow
description: Store installation_id per project and request repo permissions for deployments.
prompt: Implement OAuth-less GitHub App install callback; verify state param.

title: Slack deploy notifications
description: Send Slack message on deploy success/failure with links to logs and project page.
prompt: Support per-project webhook URL; include duration and commit sha if available.

title: Usage event tracking
description: Track deploy starts, successes, failures for billing and reliability reporting.
prompt: Emit events with project_id, deployment_id, status, latency_ms; batch to Kafka.

title: Plan limits enforcement
description: Enforce monthly deploy limits by plan; show remaining count in project details.
prompt: Compute per calendar month; cache counts; return 402-style error on overage.

title: Public API reference
description: Write concise API docs for deploy, project/task detail, update_task, get_prompt.
prompt: Include curl examples and error shapes; keep pages under 2 screens each.

title: Troubleshooting guide
description: Document common deploy failures (auth, rate limit, build errors) and next steps.
prompt: Include mapping from error_code to action; add log snippet examples < 5 lines.

title: DB index review
description: Add composite indexes for (project_id, sequence_no) and created_at ordering.
prompt: Inspect slow query log; add missing indexes; verify query plans on Postgres 15.

title: Cache project/task reads
description: Introduce short TTL cache for project + task detail endpoints to reduce DB load.
prompt: Cache key by id; invalidate on update_task and deploy completion events.
